description: Mohit Industries Limited engages in manufacturing texturized yarn from partially oriented yarn and weaving of yarn to grey cloth in India. The company offers yarn, grey, and fabric products; and exports polyester draw texturized yarns. The company also exports its products to West and South East Asia, the United Kingdom, South Korea, Italy, Spain, Germany, Mexico, Thailand, Czech Republic, Denmark, Peru, Bangladesh, South Africa, Egypt, Nepal, Brazil, Colombia, Guatemala, Vietnam, Indonesia, Bulgaria, Uzbekistan, Chili, and internationally. Mohit Industries Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Surat, India.
